The rules `htmx-contract` enforces. Each has a narrative page under Rules.

| Rule | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`empty-after-oob`](/htmx-contract/rules/empty-after-oob/) | A response empty after out-of-band extraction, without HX-Reswap: none — outerHTML deletes the target. |
| [`duplicate-id`](/htmx-contract/rules/duplicate-id/) | The same id twice in one document; htmx swaps the first match. |
| [`duplicate-field-in-form`](/htmx-contract/rules/duplicate-field-in-form/) | Two controls sharing a name inside one form; htmx lets the form override the element. |
| [`target-identity-lost`](/htmx-contract/rules/target-identity-lost/) | An outerHTML swap whose replacement does not keep the target id. |
| [`unbounded-poll`](/htmx-contract/rules/unbounded-poll/) | hx-trigger="every …" with no declared bound. |
| [`dead-target`](/htmx-contract/rules/dead-target/) | hx-target points at an id that is not in the document. |
| [`dead-oob`](/htmx-contract/rules/dead-oob/) | An out-of-band node whose target is missing, or which names no target. |
